A SQL Server gateway that gives one client connection up to three SQL Server connections behind it. Clients connect to DaffyDuo as if it were SQL Server, with a DaffyDuo login; each login starts on its default connection and switches with EXEC daffy.connect 'name' - in SSMS, in code, in any client. Each connection keeps its own server session, so temp tables, SET options and the current database survive switching back and forth; a switch is refused only while a transaction is open. Admins manage connections, logins and grants in T-SQL (EXEC daffy.help). Mandatory encryption, credentials encrypted at rest, SQL logins or Entra ID applications toward SQL Server and Azure SQL. Early release.
